evidence.fact: On the way out the party regained 1,300 ft climbing from Horseshoe Basin back up to Sahale Arm.

wa_booker_mountain_northwest_route.note: Same TR states 'Elevation gain: 7,200 feet' but it reads as the whole outing (round trip), not trailhead-to-summit; not set. Approach loss into Horseshoe Basin is given only as elevations (7,400 to 6,100), not stated as a figure. WTA TR 2019-09-28 and onehikeaweek give only elevation range 3480-8286.
